manual.pipe_valve.line2: {0}Pipe valves are redsto- mechanical devices that control fluid flow to runs of {1}pipe{2}.{3}
manual.pipe_valve.line3: Valves will not accept flow against their orientation, marked by the arrow on the central valve segment.{0}
manual.pipe_valve.line4: When a redstone signal is applied, the valve mechanism in the pipe will shut off all flow across the pump.{0}
manual.pipe_valve.line5: Pipe valves will connect to redstone acceptors such as {0}connectors{1} or levers, allowing them to be placed against the valve face.
